observation_unit.description: Individual POW record intended to represent an individual person; duplicate-card handling not stated.

sampling_unit.description: Administrative coverage of individual POWs rather than a documented probability sample; survival until camp registration affects inclusion.

assignment_unit.description: No randomized treatment assignment. Hierarchy is shared at camp/captured-cohort level; capture, transport and camp placement determine exposure. Air-service argument is a diagnostic, not proven random assignment.

native_se_method.description: Heteroskedasticity-robust covariance with stated group clustering; tables print p-values, not SEs. No finite-sample correction, test reference distribution, cluster counts for fitted samples or df given. ROC procedure is described separately and does not document cluster adjustment.

first_stage_note.description: No instrumental-variable model or first stage is described.

rationale.description: Scale is 0=absent, 1=limited, 2=substantial but incomplete, 3=fully operational. Formulas, primary estimator, many controls, scaling, groups and clusters are named. Critical code mappings, source cleaning, timing proxies, software and nonlinear effect conventions are missing. Multiple robustness families are discussed without complete estimates, sample rules or accessible appendices.

vintage_issues.item: POW card conversion and component merger
vintage_issues.description: Provider converted different card components in 1978 and 1998 and merged them in 2002. Component identity unavailable; source acquisition date/version used by authors is unstated.

Current source covers approximately 1938–1946 with documented later/invalid date codes; article gives both 1938–1946 and 1938–1945 coverage. Do not silently impose a date restriction from inconsistent descriptive prose. ERC layout and height/weight meanings differ.
Independent present-day geocoding is not the documented author geography; coarse coordinates, ambiguous names, duplicate codes and historical borders can change distances and country labels.
Only frozen published D1 supplied; excluded earlier versions cannot repair gaps. No supplied matching supplement or correction. Packet search outcome does not establish that none exists anywhere.
